github.app_creation_failed: The creation of the App "{{app}}" failed ({{why}}). If it did get created on GitHub, delete it at https://github.com/settings/apps; the next request uses another name.
github.app_device_flow: A step is missing on the App "{{app}}": open https://github.com/settings/apps/{{slug}}, tick "Enable Device Flow" and save. The Mestre checks it on its own afterwards.
github.app_install_unseen: I did not see the installation of the App "{{app}}" in 1 hour. Install it at https://github.com/apps/{{slug}}/installations/new and open the link back that GitHub shows, or ask the Grand Master for the status.
github.app_link_expired: The link to create the App "{{app}}" expired. Ask for another in the panel (GitHub Apps) or from the Grand Master; meanwhile the class keeps the App "Mestre".
github.app_not_used: The App "{{app}}" will not be used: {{why}}. If it exists on GitHub, delete it at https://github.com/settings/apps.
github.belongs_to_other_table: #{{number}} belongs to another table; ask the Grand Master.
github.block_unknown: The block "{{block}}" does not exist; the blocks are {{blocks}}.
github.force_master_only: The force push is only for the Mestre of the table.
github.force_on_main: The force push on the main branch is not done.
github.force_table_branch: The force push is only on the branch of the table ({{branch}}).
github.force_unknown_main: Without the main branch known, or if the branch of the table is the main one, the force push is not done.
github.is_pr_not_issue: #{{number}} is a PR, not an issue.
github.is_pr_use_pr: #{{number}} is a PR, not an issue; use mestre pr.
github.issue_in_other_epic: The issue #{{number}} belongs to epic #{{epic}}, of another table; ask the Grand Master.
github.issue_is_other_epic: The issue #{{number}} is an epic of another table; ask the Grand Master.
github.issue_not_in_tree: The issue #{{number}} is not in the tree of epic #{{epic}} of the table; ask the Grand Master.
github.label_grand_master: The label {{label}} is reserved: only the Grand Master adds or removes it.
github.label_grand_master_and_people: The label {{label}} is reserved: only the Grand Master and the people add it.
github.label_people_remove: The label {{label}} is reserved: only the people remove it, through GitHub or the panel.
github.no_epic: The table {{table}} has no registered epic.
github.other_repo: The table {{table}} works in {{tableRepo}}, not in {{repo}}; ask the Grand Master.
github.pr_not_of_table: The PR #{{number}} is not of the table {{table}}; ask the Grand Master.
github.push_to_main: Pushing to the main branch is not done: the table works on its own branch.
github.target_kind: The target is an issue or a PR; a comment counts for what contains it.
